subject: Request: Executive signoff for MFN + limited competitive access carve-out (Veridian)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Executive signoff for MFN + limited competitive access carve-out (Veridian)

Team —

Quick summary: Veridian Analytics (proof-of-concept running on our hosted API) is asking for a commercial package to win a multi-region pilot across their analytics customers. Key asks from the customer: a) a Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) price protection for 12 months, b) limited competitive-access / exclusivity for a single benchmark integration (their "MarketPulse" connector) while the pilot runs, and c) a 35% list discount tied to committed monthly usage.

Why this matters: Veridian is a strategically valuable early adopter in the financial analytics vertical and could drive multiple introductions to tier-1 IBs. The ARR upside is material if we lock the pilot in and can convert to Dedicated capacity next year. Procurement is pushing to close before their fiscal quarter ends (10 Aug).

Risks we flagged: MFN + exclusivity is a high-risk combo (pricing lock + feature-restriction). The customer redlines also include a broad MFN definition (any price offered to any customer) and a clause that would prevent us from offering lower prices to prospects in this vertical. I attached the proposal and their redlines.

Ask: I need an executive decision on whether Deal Desk can sign a 12-month MFN limited to (i) price tiers only (not contractual commercial terms), and (ii) a carve-out that excludes any enterprise transactions above $500k ARR. Also need confirmation on whether we can grant the narrow benchmark exclusivity to MarketPulse for 6 months limited to NA region. If approved, legal will draft protective language (sunset, telemetry, carve-outs).

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf, veridian_redlines.docx, commercial_summary.xlsx

Proposed interim position (my recommendation): Approve conditional MFN (price only) + 6-month region-limited exclusivity for the MarketPulse connector, in exchange for an upfront commitment and a break clause if volume thresholds aren't met after 3 months. This balances the risk and commercial upside.

Timeline: Veridian expects final terms by COB Mon 2 Aug.

Thanks — happy to jump on 15–20 min to walk through language.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Executive signoff for MFN + limited competitive access carve-out (Veridian)

Priya —

Thanks for the clear summary. High level thoughts:
- MFN + exclusivity is a material product/price constraint. If MFN is defined as "any lower price offered to any customer," we should not approve. That effectively ties our hands on future discounting.
- If Legal can narrow MFN to "price tiers for equivalent committed volumes in the same region and product tier" and add a definite sunset (12 months) + audit/telemetry rights, I'm open to conditional approval.
- Exclusivity to the MarketPulse connector for NA for 6 months is acceptable only if: (a) it is feature-level (not platform-level) and (b) we include a clause that allows us to continue existing partnerships and prospective integrations. No global exclusivity.

Please share the exact redlined MFN language from Veridian and the customer's commercial rationale — I want to ensure this isn't an attempt to extract parity with a future custom deal. Also confirm the financial cadence (monthly committed USD) and whether the 35% discount is off list or off our standard enterprise price.

If the numbers check out and Legal agrees to the carve-outs/sunsets, I will escalate to Marissa for final exec signoff.

-Rishi
VP, Deal Desk

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Sarah Liu <s.liu@veridian.ai>, Joel Kim <joel.kim@veridian.ai>, procurement@veridian.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 10:43:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Veridian redlines + commercial justification — details inside

Forwarding the customer's redlines and their justification below so Legal/Deal Desk sees the ask in context. Highlighted excerpts:

---- forwarded message ----
From: Sarah Liu <s.liu@veridian.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Joel Kim <joel.kim@veridian.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 07:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal and redlines

Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple points from our side:
1) The MFN is to protect our pricing while we invest in certifying MarketPulse for our customers. We cannot justify the engineering and GTM spend without price protection for the pilot.
2) The limited exclusivity request is to ensure early co-marketing and joint-customer references while the integration is immature. We are not asking for a platform-wide exclusivity.
3) The 35% discount is off your public enterprise pricing (not off a negotiated special).

We are comfortable with a 6-month exclusivity tied to MarketPulse in NA and with an audit right (we will not unreasonably exercise it).

— Sarah
---- end forwarded message ----

Customer asks are reasonably narrow; they emphasize co-marketing and pilot economics. Proposed compromise we briefed Rishi on (included in attachments) also attempts to protect Redwood: narrow MFN to price tiers, carve out future enterprise (> $500k ARR) deals, require telemetry checks and a 30-day re-pricing trigger if volume outperforms.

Next steps: Legal needs to review their redlines and map to acceptable carve-outs. Rishi — attaching the verbatim redline file (veridian_redlines.docx) and a short commercial_summary.xlsx that shows committed spend and revenue math.

Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Executive signoff for MFN + limited competitive access carve-out (Veridian)

Folks —

I reviewed the materials quickly and agree with Rishi's assessment. Given the strategic potential and the restricted scope Veridian is asking for, I will APPROVE a conditional concession with the following firm guardrails:

1) MFN: APPROVED only as a price-tier parity for equivalent committed volumes and product tier, limited to 12 months. MFN must explicitly exclude any enterprise transactions > $500k ARR and must not apply to partner marketplace promotions. Legal to add explicit exclusion language.

2) Exclusivity: APPROVED for MarketPulse connector only, limited to 6 months and NA region. Exclusivity must be feature-scoped and exclude existing partnerships. If Veridian asks to extend beyond 6 months, they must demonstrate usage thresholds and pay a premium.

3) Pricing: APPROVED to a maximum of 35% off list for the pilot, contingent on an upfront monthly minimum commitment (see commercial_summary.xlsx). Any deeper discount requires separate exec signoff.

4) Legal & Compliance: Require telemetry and audit clauses (right to review usage patterns monthly) and a clear re-pricing trigger if volume exceeds the committed thresholds. Legal to prepare the final language with sunset and audit scope by Tue 3 Aug COB.

5) Operational: Sales to track the contract in the "MFN carve-out" log and set a 30-day automatic review after pilot month 3. Product to be alerted if any API or feature gating is necessary.

Priya — proceed to negotiate under these constraints. Rishi / Karthik, please loop Legal and Contract Ops now and get the redlines prepared. Marissa 

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations (interim), Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
